data.summary_en: VideoHarness-SRSI constrains its proposer with content-free feedback, organizes search via instrumented warm-up experiments and isolated probe-race branches, and evolves video harnesses through factor combination and joint refinement; on video understanding benchmarks, its equal-weight average held-out score improves 6.2% over VideoHarness-BRSI; average validation-test gap shrinks 37.9%.
